content:
GOAL: Establish the discriminating evidence before ranking the three deepest-level relabel proposals (gromovcrit-deepest-split, HORO-TRANSPLANT-L, GROMOV4-MARGIN-GATE-SID).
READ: the three frozen bundles cf0a8c8be17804d3, 735c028526119499, 7b70423833611cca; shared items E4-E11 plus the geometric-necessity items E12-E14.
OBSERVED: E6 width-20 beam survival: l1_br recall@10 0.04671 with gold prefix alive at depth 1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068; l1_br_euclid 0.06207 at 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085; l1_only 0.06233 at 1.000/0.829/0.156/0.086; resample 0.06363 at 0.497/0.122/0.091/0.088; target SID inside 20 beams 0.0678-0.0884. E7 teacher-forced T4 NLL: l1_br 9.03 vs 1.19-1.23 for the better variants. E5 successor entropy bins: top-1 mass 0.4375 (H=0.931, support 2.8) vs 0.0543 (H=3.405, support 44.3), Spearman -0.973. E8 first-level capacity: share of canonical pairs sharing a cluster 0.3106 at K=16 vs 0.0822 at K=256. E10 (HORO bundle) branch degree median 3, p10 1, p90 10, 21,699 items with successors, mean branch entropy 1.108 nats; E10 (other bundles) 115,582 distinct edges, edge density 5.3266, mean out-degree 5.4526. E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067.
EVIDENCE: bundle items E5-E11 in all three bundles.
REASONING: the evidence localises the baseline failure at the deepest token (depth-4 survival 0.068, T4 NLL 9.03, recall bounded by target-in-beam 0.0678-0.0884), so all three mechanisms aim at the right level; the discriminators are (a) whether the move predicate is safe against the heavy-tailed successor counts of E5 and the roughly 20/256 depth-4 coverage of E6, (b) whether the curved quantity is load-bearing rather than a near-Euclidean rescaling, and (c) whether the deciding equations actually exist in the specification. E8's small-K result argues against raising the deepest-code count.
OPEN: per-proposal placement and final ordering.

GOAL: Assess each of the three proposals against the frozen evidence and the one-run / no-sweep policy.
READ: full IDEA blocks plus their bundles (cf0a8c8be17804d3, 735c028526119499, 7b70423833611cca).
OBSERVED: HORO-TRANSPLANT-L: behaviour (transition counts M, popularity-normalised child flow) only nominates the destination sibling; the accept decision is curved (Busemann/horosphere height h_{p,b} and geodesic no-harm Delta_i<=0 against the child anchor), so no move can increase the item's geodesic distance to the child it is transplanted into; levels 1..L-1 and the deepest vocabulary are bit-identical, one synchronous pass, constant-free sign test. gromovcrit-deepest-split: complete equations, successor Poincare barycentres plus a prefix-conditional deepest-code confusion table propose the move, Poincare margin M1>M0 and a Gromov-delta cut certificate admit it, zero added per-step cost; but the C1 band N(p,k1)-N(p,k2)<=sqrt(N(p,k1)) is not mass-restricted (E5 heavy tail, E10 median branch degree 3 / mean out-degree 5.45 makes many low-count prefixes critical), the split raises the deepest-code count where E6 depth-4 survival is already ~20/256=0.078 and E8 says smaller K keeps behavioural neighbours together (0.3106 at K=16 vs 0.0822 at K=256), and Step 5 ("only items in S* may change") is ambiguous about the non-S* members of the split code k1. GROMOV4-MARGIN-GATE-SID: SPEC step (6) defers the move predicate and greedy acceptance to "SPEC EQUATIONS" that are not present, so criterion 5 is not met for the deciding computation; its curvature c=1/max(delta_G,1) comes from the four-point defect of a hop metric on the sparse E10 graph, so delta_G is likely large, kappa=-c^2 near zero and the margin test close to Euclidean (a risk it lists itself); its entropy-eligible and frozen-cell-size capacity gates are the one part well grounded in E5 and E8.
EVIDENCE: E5, E6, E7, E8, E10, E11 in the three bundles; SPEC text of each proposal.
REASONING: HORO is the only proposal whose precision gate is an explicit curved no-harm test against the frozen quantiser's own anchors, and it leaves the vocabulary and prefix levels untouched, which preserves the 1.000 depth-1-3 survival that every better-than-baseline variant in E6 relies on; its main risk is an empty move set (Delta_i<=0 may be rare because membership means sit at their own cells), which is a falsifiable null rather than a self-inflicted broad edit. gromovcrit is complete and genuinely coupled but its predicate is over-permissive on low-count prefixes and its split direction conflicts with E6 coverage and E8 capacity. gromov4 cannot be executed as specified and its geometry risks collapsing to Euclidean.
OPEN: final ordering and one-line evidence-grounded reasons.

GOAL: Deliver the final ranking of the three proposals.
READ: evidence items E5-E11 of the three frozen bundles and the full proposal specifications.
OBSERVED: final order HORO-TRANSPLANT-L first, gromovcrit-deepest-split second, GROMOV4-MARGIN-GATE-SID third.
EVIDENCE: E6 depth-4 collapse (gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068, recall 0.04671) and E7 T4 NLL 9.03 for the baseline; E5 successor-entropy stratification (top-1 0.4375 vs 0.0543); E10 branch degree median 3 / 21,699 items with successors and mean out-degree 5.4526; E8 small-K advantage 0.3106 vs 0.0822; E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs 0.067.
REASONING: recorded in the two preceding records; the deciding factors are precision safety against the frozen quantiser, direction of the edit relative to the 20-beam depth-4 coverage and E8's small-K lesson, and whether the core equations exist.
OPEN: none. Complete answer follows in this record.

RANK: HORO-TRANSPLANT-L | position=1 | reason=Only this mechanism lets behaviour merely nominate the sibling while the curved test against that child's frozen anchor (D_i>=0 horoball, Delta_i<=0 geodesic no-harm) decides, so a move cannot fight the quantiser, and E6/E7 show the baseline failure is exactly depth-4 (prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068, recall 0.04671, T4 NLL 9.03) while keeping levels 1..L-1 and the vocabulary bit-identical preserves the depth-1-3 survival that all better variants (0.06207-0.06363) rely on; the behaviour input is measured in E5 (top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543) and E10 (median branch degree 3, 21,699 items with successors), and both gates are derived quantiles/signs so one run needs no sweep.
RANK: gromovcrit-deepest-split | position=2 | reason=Its equations are complete and the coupling is real (successor barycentres and the prefix confusion table propose the move, Poincare margin M1>M0 and the Gromov-delta certificate admit it, zero added per-step cost) and it targets the same depth-4 bottleneck in E6/E7, but C1 N(p,k1)-N(p,k2)<=sqrt(N(p,k1)) is not mass-restricted, so with E5's heavy tail (top-1 0.0543, support 44.3) and E10's mean out-degree 5.4526 it flags many low-count prefixes, and its split raises the deepest-code count just where E6 depth-4 survival is already ~20/256=0.078 and E8 shows smaller K keeps behavioural neighbours together better (0.3106 at K=16 vs 0.0822 at K=256), so the claimed precision-first small move set is not enforced by its own predicate.
RANK: GROMOV4-MARGIN-GATE-SID | position=3 | reason=Its SPEC step (6) defers the move predicate and greedy acceptance to "SPEC EQUATIONS" that are absent, so the deciding computation has no equations and misses criterion 5; its geometry is the weakest, since delta_G measured by the four-point defect of a hop metric on the E10 graph (mean out-degree 5.4526, 115,582 edges) will be large, making c=1/max(delta_G,1) small, kappa=-c^2 near zero and the margin test close to Euclidean (a risk it lists itself); the entropy-eligible and frozen-cell-size capacity gates are the only part well grounded in E5 and E8, which is not enough to rescue the missing predicate.
